buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder are advised to check application GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any respon sibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rate (whichever is lo wer), subject to the maximum of quoted GST%. 2. All firms are requested to participated in the bid as per the BBQRs. The same is attached under the "Spe cification Documents". Bidders offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates/ documents sought in the bid documents, AT&C and corrigendum, if any. 5 Bidders shall submit the following documents along with their bid for vendor code creation: 5.1. Copy of canceled checque 5.2. Copy of PAN card 5.3.Copy of GSTIN 5.4. Copy of NEFT Mandate Duly Certified by bank. 6. Liquidated Damages (LD) clause will be imposed as per extant rules/ guidelines, is the supplier fails to supply the products within the delivery period.

7. Law. The Contract shall be considered and made in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India. Th e contract shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India. 8. Penalty for use of Undue influence. The Seller undertakes that he has not given, offered or promised to give, directly or indirectly, any gift, consideration, reward, commission, fees, brokerage or inducement to a ny person in service of the Buyer or otherwise in procuring the Contracts or forbearing to do or for having done or forborne to do any act in relation to the obtaining or execution of the present Contract or any othe r Contract with the Government of India for showing or forbearing to showfavour or disfavour to any perso n in relation to the present Contract or any other Contract with the Government of India. Any breach of the aforesaid undertaking by the Seller or anyone employed by him or acting on his behalf (whether with or wi thout the knowledge of the Seller) or the commission of any offers by the Seller or anyone employed by hi m or acting on his behalf, as defined in Chapter IX of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 or the Prevention of Corr uption Act, 1986 or of any other Actenacted for the prevention of corruption shall entitle the Buyer to canc el the contract and all or any other contracts with the Seller and recover from the Seller the amount of any loss arising from such cancellation. A decision of the Buyer of his representative to the effect that a breach of the undertaking had been committed shall be final and binding on the Seller. Giving or offering of any gi ft, bribe or inducement or any attempt at any such act on behalf of the Seller towards any officer/employe e of the Buyer or to any other person in a position to influence any officer employee of the Buyer for showi ng any favour in relation to this or any other contract, shall render the Seller to such liability/penalty as th e Buyer may deem proper, including but not limited to termination of the contract, imposition of penal dam ages, forfeiture of the Bank Guarantee and refund of the amounts paid by the Buyer. 9. Mandatory - Technical Evaluation Conditions 10. The bidder shall submit an item wise Technical Compliance Statement covering 100% of the paramete rs specified in the BBQRs, with reference to the corresponding page/ section of the submitted technical lite rature. Unsupported claims of compliance shall not be considered. 11. Liquidated Damages. In the event of the Seller's failure to submit the Bonds, Guarantees and Documen ts, supply the stores/goods and conduct trials, installation of equipment, training, etc as specified in this c ontract, the Buyer may, at its discretion, withhold any payment until the completion of the contract. The B uyer may deduct from the CONTRACTOR as agreed, liquidated damages to the sum of 0.5% of the contract price of the delayed/undelivered stores/services mentioned above for every week of delay or part of a wee k, subject to the maximum value of the Liquidated Damages being not higher than 10% of the value of del ayed stores. 12. Notice. Any notice required or permitted by the contract shall be written in the English language and may be delivered personally or may be sent by FAX or registered prepaid/mail/airmail, addressed to the la st known address of the party to whom it is sent. 13. Taxes and Duties. 14. CONTRACTOR must indicate separately the relevant Taxes/ Duties likely to be paid in connection with delivery of completed goods specifiedin RFP. In absence of this, the total cost quoted by them in their bids will be taken into account in the ranking of bids. 15. If CONTRACTOR is exempted from payment of any duty/tax upto any value of supplies from them, he s hould clearly state that no such duty/tax will be charged by them up to the limit of exemption which they may have. If any concession is available in regard to rate/ quantum of any duty/tax, it should be brought o ut clearly. In such cases, relevant certificate will be issued by the Buyer later to enable the Seller to obtain exemptions from taxation authorities. 16. Levies, taxes and duties levied by Central/Sate/ Local governments such as Goods & Services Tax (GS T) on final product will be paid by the Buyer and they may not be indicated separately in the bid. CONTRACTOR is required to include the same in the pricing of their product.

17. Payment Terms. Payment through NEFT/RTGs will be made by AAO (Ezhimala) on submission of thedut y pre-receipted and stamped bill. 18. Advanced Payment. NO advanced payment will be made to contractor In any stage. All the payments will be done only after duly submission of work completion certificate from contractor, join inspection and buyers inspection. On completion of inspection, buyer issues a satisfactory certificate and payment will be done thereafter. Bidder compliance and documentation required:- 19. All participating bidders must strictly fulfill and conform to the technical specifications uploaded by the buyer. Non-compliance with the prescribed parameters with render the bid liable for disqualification. 20. Mandatory. Bidder are required to upload clear, high-quality image/ photography of the specific good s offered to verify visual and physical alignment. 21. Bidder qualification is contingent upon absolute adherence to the technical criteria and mandatory doc ument uploads specified in the bid. .
